workspace.text:

- Wed 15:00/15:30: David busy both times, Elena busy at 15:30
- Thu 10:00: Elena busy (Hiring panel)
- Fri 11:00/11:30: Both busy

However, I found the following times when BOTH Elena and David are free. Could you check if Priya and Marcus are available during any of these?

- Tue: 9:00 or 9:30
- Wed: 13:00 or 13:30
- Thu: 9:30, 14:30, or 15:00
